about: AR68 M, the top-left: A, the card and the blade (research's pick, 2026-11-27, 14:29), for the game's plate. Points are the 568 frame's, in the lead group's: the frame's less group.offset. Each image is laid at its box as it is (Pad 0, no slices). Z orders the plate's parts from 1. MLeadPlate, MHealthFill and MLevelTab replace today's images of those names; MHealthLag and MLeadBustRook are new.

group.note: the group's top left in the frame's points, from the old plate's top edge in m_day_fight (to half a point)

lays.note: the card and the blade, their shadow and ink, the health's and the experience's troughs
the lead's bust, MLeadBust<Name> at its own box (Rook's here): held by the card's sides and foot, the hair free over the card's top

lays.image: today's portrait art (CardFace<Name> and CardHead<Name>, or CardFaceUnknown<Rarity>)
lays.note: square, clipped to this box, inside the card's slant

the last hit's chip: the image whole inside a clipping frame at this box, the frame Root + Span times the chip's share wide (see live.health). On a hit it holds at the old share, then drains to the new one a beat after the fill; on a heal it moves with the fill

the health: the image whole (never stretched: its grain stays still) inside a clipping frame at this box, the frame Root + Span times the share wide, at least Least while any is left; its moving end is straight
the level's tab on the card's foot

health.note: the clip's width from its box's left: Root + Span x share (Root: where the trough's slanted foot starts; Span: to its top right corner, so all health fills it all)

edge.note: a Frame, its right edge at the fill's clip's right; shown while 0 < share < 0.99

xp.note: a Frame, the share to the next level of the box wide, a gradient from lit at its top to colour

marks.note: the kit's gem (the type) and class mark: the gem's centre `after` past the name's right (TextBounds), the mark's centre `after` past the gem's. The target paints them lacquered (the finish's)

texts.edge: the dark Edge: a UIStroke #0B0C10, opaque, 1.3 pt, and the same word again 1 pt lower in #0B0C10 under it
texts.fit: its room is 97 wide from x: a name wider steps its size down to fit (by TextBounds), never under 12; never cut short (names: each name's size as measured here)

texts.what: health: the share, two spaces, a slash, two spaces, the most ('2,518  /  4,061'), one weight
texts.edge: the dark Edge: a UIStroke #0B0C10, opaque, 1.2 pt, and the same word again 1 pt lower in #0B0C10 under it
the dark Edge: a UIStroke #0B0C10, opaque, 1.2 pt, and the same word again 1 pt lower in #0B0C10 under it

texts.what: the last hit's damage, rising as today
texts.edge: the dark Edge: a UIStroke #0B0C10, opaque, 1.1 pt, and the same word again 1 pt lower in #0B0C10 under it
texts.note: not in the picked target: placed over the blade's right end, on the world, clear of the name's row; research's eye in the game

live.font: Montserrat (rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json), Heavy, every word; sizes are the frame's em: set over the build's measured scale for Montserrat as for Oswald (Em)
